description.value: Level V Bakery is a 100% plant-based bakery tucked into Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, founded in 2017 by a self-taught baker who grew the business from a home kitchen into a brick-and-mortar shop. Everything is made from scratch — no dairy, no eggs — with a rotating lineup of cakes, pastries, buns, cookies, macarons, and cream puffs, plus gluten-free and nut-free options. Cyclists passing through the area can stop in for daily walk-in stock or pre-order items for pickup.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content fully corroborates OSM tags: address, phone, and vegan-only designation all match. The bakery operates primarily as a pre-order and same-day pickup shop, confirming takeout as the business model. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site; FAQ references only car/paid parking nearby.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible vegan bakery with confirmed address and operating hours. A clear stop for plant-based food options along the Kingsway corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: FAQ notes that free street parking is sometimes available nearby, and the Mount Pleasant Community Centre has a paid parking lot accessed from the alley — no mention of bike parking specifically.
